news_flags.headline: Gators' Boogie Fland aggravates shoulder injury, status vs. Houston in question
news_flags.description: Boogie Fland left the Gators' 86-78 win over Notre Dame after aggravating a right shoulder injury, and his availability for the Houston game is uncertain.

news_flags.headline: Jayhawks' Tyran Stokes sits due to bone bruise; status vs. Houston up in air
news_flags.description: Kansas freshman Tyran Stokes suffered a bone bruise in his knee during the Jayhawks' game a night earlier and is day-to-day.

news_flags.headline: Solo Ball is ahead of schedule just in time for UConn
news_flags.description: Solo Ball was thought to be out for the season, but his injury recovery has progressed faster than expected.

news_flags.headline: UConn's Solo Ball nearing surprise return amid rehab from wrist surgery
news_flags.description: UConn guard Solo Ball has been cleared for a return to full-contact practice after offseason wrist surgery, with the expectation that he'll return to game action this season.

news_flags.headline: Michigan State's Jordan Scott injures right shoulder in win over Northern Iowa
news_flags.description: Jordan Scott injured his right shoulder as No. 5 Michigan State beat Northern Iowa 106-72 on Friday night.
